summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for the advanced nuclear component and fuel-fabrication node. The cleanest reference leader remains BWX Technologies because it has explicit naval nuclear propulsion, nuclear components, HEU processing, and TRISO fuel exposure. The underfollowed discovery lane is stronger in HALEU enrichment, TRISO fuel fabrication, and prospective isotope/enrichment technology than in broad reactor-development equities. Centrus, X-energy, and ASP Isotopes are included because their exposure maps directly to fuel bottlenecks rather than only to reactor ownership. Several claims remain hypothesis-level because advanced fuel revenues are early-stage, regulated, and dependent on licensing, DOE support, customer qualification, and commercial-scale execution. Expanded the node around regulated nuclear fuel, advanced fuel fabrication, reactor components, naval nuclear propulsion supply, and qualification-heavy nuclear hardware. The cleanest public-market chokepoint candidates are not speculative reactor developers but suppliers tied to HALEU enrichment, nuclear components, naval propulsion, and advanced fuel technology. This pass keeps BWXT as the reference anchor, elevates LEU and CW as investable supply-chain candidates, and adds LTBR only as a below-USD-300M speculative shadow because its relevance is fuel-technology optionality rather than proven scaled production.
